goal: Identify an interpretable shared-coefficient astrology architecture that has stable out-of-sample signal and incremental predictive value beyond chronology/age/axis/wave nuisance.

datasets.BROAD_use: fixed-algorithm sensitivity only; no architecture invented from BROAD results

feature_principles.pair_difference: positive-year astrology primitives minus negative-year primitives
feature_principles.reason_shinsal_excluded: Avoid reopening the high-dimensional feature-search problem before lower-dimensional orthodox primitives earn signal.

candidate_architectures.name: SW_TG10_L2
candidate_architectures.features: Sewoon exact 10-Ten-God stem + branch hidden-stem distribution

candidate_architectures.name: DW_SW_TG10_L2
candidate_architectures.features: Daewoon + Sewoon exact 10-Ten-God stem + branch hidden-stem distributions

candidate_architectures.name: DW_SW_TG10_REL_L2
candidate_architectures.features: DW_SW_TG10 + stem/branch relations to natal and Daewoon↔Sewoon

candidate_architectures.name: ORTHODOX_CORE_L2
candidate_architectures.features: DW/SW exact Ten-God + dynamic element/yinyang + relations + Yongshin fit + 12-Unseong

candidate_architectures.name: ORTHODOX_CORE_STRENGTH_L2
candidate_architectures.features: ORTHODOX_CORE + exact dynamic Ten-God × natal strength bucket interactions

candidate_architectures.name: ORTHODOX_CORE_ELASTICNET_AUTO
candidate_architectures.features: Same shared orthodox-core feature universe including strength interactions
candidate_architectures.model: ElasticNet logistic with inner subject-CV hyperparameter selection

diagnostic_models.NUISANCE_ONLY: Signed chronology/age information interacted with axis and collection wave; no astrology.
diagnostic_models.NUISANCE_PLUS_ASTRO: NUISANCE_ONLY plus candidate astrology features; diagnostic only, never production architecture.

winner_rule: Among architectures passing all gates on PRIMARY with required BROAD/wave sensitivity, choose highest PRIMARY astrology-only subject-macro accuracy; break ties by larger conditional N+Astro vs nuisance delta, then simpler architecture order.
if_winner: Freeze architecture and full-PRIMARY astrology-only model coefficients. Next phase may benchmark Production Control without retuning the astrology architecture.
if_no_winner: Do not open CONFIRM. Diagnose feature representation/mechanism using DEV only; do not return to automatic whole-wave expansion.
